# All Tutorials

A complete alphabetical listing of every tutorial on the site. Use the search box to filter titles, topics, tags and dates.

::: {#tutorials-table}
Loading…
:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function() {
  const container = document.getElementById('tutorials-table');
  try {
    const resp = await fetch('artifacts/graph.json');
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('Tutorial index unavailable');
    const graph = await resp.json();
    const rows = graph.nodes || [];
    rows.sort((a, b) => (a.title || '').localeCompare(b.title || ''));
    container.replaceChildren();
    const label = document.createElement('label');
    label.htmlFor = 'az-search'; label.textContent = 'Search tutorials';
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.id = 'az-search'; input.type = 'search'; input.className = 'form-control mb-3';
    const table = document.createElement('table');
    table.className = 'table table-striped';
    table.style.minWidth = '48rem';
    const scroll = document.createElement('div');
    scroll.className = 'table-responsive'; scroll.tabIndex = 0;
    scroll.setAttribute('role','region');
    scroll.setAttribute('aria-label','Tutorial results; scroll horizontally for all columns');
    const head = table.createTHead().insertRow();
    for (const title of ['Title','Topic','Tags','Date']) {
      const th = document.createElement('th'); th.scope = 'col'; th.textContent = title;
      head.appendChild(th);
    }
    const body = table.createTBody();
    for (const item of rows) {
      const row = body.insertRow(); row.className = 'tutorial-row';
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      const url = new URL(item.url, window.location.href);
      if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) throw new Error('Unexpected tutorial origin');
      link.href = url.href; link.textContent = item.title;
      const titleCell = row.insertCell(); titleCell.style.minWidth = '18rem';
      titleCell.appendChild(link);
      for (const value of [item.topic, (item.tags || []).join('; '), item.date])
        row.insertCell().textContent = value || '';
    }
    scroll.appendChild(table);
    container.append(label,input,scroll);

    document.getElementById('az-search').addEventListener('input', function(e) {
      const q = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
      document.querySelectorAll('.tutorial-row').forEach(row => {
        row.style.display = row.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q) ? '' : 'none';
      });
    });
  } catch(err) {
    container.textContent = 'The tutorial index could not be loaded. Reload the page or browse by topic.';
  }
});
</script>
```
